rationale: The fmt_cost flag appears to be triggered by missing repeated currency-symbol cells on continuation rows, not by a wrong cost value. In the raw SOI, table 10 row 22 omits the dollar symbol in the par/cost/fair-value symbol cells, but the numeric cost 181 is still in the Cost column and row 23 rolls it into the combined Clarience subtotal: 144,359 + 181 = 144,540. The schedule total also reports Total Investments cost of 8,420,468, matching the anchor used here. Source therefore supports the stored cost values and shows a filing/table-format convention rather than a data defect.
